reason: Regions the accessibility gate's reflow measure (M18, WCAG 1.4.10, OpenSpec change accessibility-aa D2) lets scroll sideways inside themselves at 320 CSS px. Only content whose meaning needs two dimensions belongs here: the page around it must still not scroll sideways.

regions.reason: Day and Week time grids: hours down, days across; a day column narrower than a time slot can no longer show a block.
Project timeline: tasks down, dates across.
Board columns (and a saved view as a board): sections across, cards down; at 320 px one column fills the width and the next scrolls into view.
Tasks and fields as a data table: rows of tasks, a column per field.
A code block keeps its lines (wrapping changes the meaning of code) and a Markdown table its columns.
Statistics tables and calendar heatmaps: weeks across, days down.
The import preview is a data table of the file's columns.
